summary: Pine Tree Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq (units PAXGU, Class A PAXG, rights PAXGR), filed an 8-K reporting that its Form S-1 for an initial public offering was declared effective October 5, 2026, and that it priced the IPO on October 6, 2026, per an attached press release. The filing attaches executed IPO-related agreements—underwriting (Maxim Group LLC as representative), trust, registration rights, administrative services, insider letter, and private placement units purchase agreements with Pine Tree Sponsor Group and North Penn—plus amended articles. No deal price, trust size, or business combination target is disclosed in the excerpt; watch trust funding, overhang from sponsor/private placement units, and the 18-24 month combination clock.
